name: Fruit Ninja vs Skittles
summary: Fruit Ninja meets Skittles, the famous fruit-flavored candy. In this special version of the game, basic gameplay remains the same, but in addition to regular fruit, there are Skittles to cut through too! With clean cuts, you slice in half the items that appear on your screen: pineapple, coconut, watermelon, strawberries, lemons, apples, pears, kiwi and so on, in addition to Skittles. This game was downloadable via a QR code on specially marked packets of Skittles, but could only be played for a limited period.
